question: While the man in the dark short-sleeve shirt was wiping his hands at the kitchen sink, what was the state of the skillet on the stovetop island?
options: Full of clear water
Covered with chopped vegetables

reason: The skillet was filled with the mixed egg mixture (C). At 55s the bowl he rinses in the sink is empty, so the eggs were already poured.

question: While the man in the black T-shirt and dark glasses was getting the white bowl-like plate from the metal counter, what was the state of the pale dressing in the squeeze bottle?

reason: The answer is (B): he had already poured some of the dressing, so the bottle was no longer full. At 168s the exo view shows the man in the black T-shirt and dark glasses holding the squeeze bottle upside down over the metal mixing bowl, pouring dressing onto the salad.
